panels.title: Daily Log Submitted by Local Hour

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ts) as hr, COUNT(*) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'daily_log_submitted' AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY hr ORDER BY hr
SELECT current_streak, COUNT(*) FROM user_streak GROUP BY current_streak ORDER BY current_streak
SELECT team_id, COUNT(*) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'streak_frozen' AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY team_id
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', ts) as week, COUNT(*) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'streak_broken' AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY week ORDER BY week
